isResolved.description: IsResolved is whether the identity could be resolved at all.

userRef.description: UserRef is the reference of the resolved Cluster User.

externalID.description: ExternalID is the identifier of the resolved external actor.

source.title: Source
source.description: Source is how the link was established

integrationIdentityRef.description: IntegrationIdentityRef is the reference of the IntegrationIdentity that carries the link.

detail.description: Detail explains why the resolution succeeded or failed.

ResolveIntegrationIdentityResponse.title: Resolve Integration Identity Response
ResolveIntegrationIdentityResponse.description: ResolveIntegrationIdentityResponse is the response of the ResolveIntegrationIdentity method.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the API version of the reference resource

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind. A kind is unique per an APIVersion.

uid.description: UID is the resource object UID. A UID is unique across the entire Cluster.

name.description: Name is the resource object name. A name is unique per a certain kind.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is the resourceVersion of the resource.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.title: Object Reference
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.description: ObjectReference is a reference to another Cluster resource. It identifies the referenced resource by its kind and either its UID or its name.
